text: Topological sorting of extracted subgraph contexts produces causal, dependency-ordered prompt serialization that minimizes attention dispersion in autoregressive language models.
Redundancy-aware graph compaction collapses intermediate bridging nodes while preserving geodesic paths between query entities and factual targets, reducing prompt token consumption by 35%–50%.
Dynamic context window budgeting assigns token allocations proportionally to graph community centrality and node degree, preventing peripheral entity noise from displacing core factual evidence.
